about: Fairs and seasonal markets of the time (Plans/ai_fleets.md, phase 6): on their days a market fills with goods and buyers (its stock times stock_x, its prices moved by dearer: below 0 cheaper, more sellers), news of it goes out from the place, and the world's traders follow the prices there. Starting guesses; uncertain items marked (?).
